Kawaii palettes

Source: R/palette-objects.R
kawaii_palettes.Rd

The 30 palettes of the Kawaii collection, each a character vector of hex colours in printed swatch order.

kawaii_tri_01

Format

A character vector of hex colour strings.

kawaii_bi_01: bicolor, 2 colours (#5C4D8C, #D0D959).

kawaii_tri_01: tricolor, 3 colours (#F4C8DD, #0097DC, #3BB699).

kawaii_tri_02: tricolor, 3 colours (#4AB0DF, #D84D96, #8255A0).

kawaii_tri_03: tricolor, 3 colours (#E7BB7F, #E5C2DB, #EADFCA).

kawaii_tri_04: tricolor, 3 colours (#FFF462, #AFD9B9, #AFC0E3).

kawaii_tri_05: tricolor, 3 colours (#DE1628, #27B28D, #F2CB4F).

kawaii_tri_06: tricolor, 3 colours (#207EB8, #2D7C3A, #EEDD28).

kawaii_tri_07: tricolor, 3 colours (#3D7EB4, #DF4472, #E68C5F).

kawaii_tri_08: tricolor, 3 colours (#FADBDA, #AFD9B9, #FFFCD1).

kawaii_tri_09: tricolor, 3 colours (#FFF462, #FADBDA, #7ECEF4).

kawaii_tri_10: tricolor, 3 colours (#FADBDA, #C8E7E9, #AFC0E3).

kawaii_tri_11: tricolor, 3 colours (#FCEAD4, #470B00, #FDD700).

kawaii_tri_12: tricolor, 3 colours (#F7E2E7, #500047, #FDD700).

kawaii_tri_13: tricolor, 3 colours (#F9F21E, #B6977B, #A488D3).

kawaii_tri_14: tricolor, 3 colours (#1D967A, #FDD35C, #E94D3B).

kawaii_tri_15: tricolor, 3 colours (#FFF462, #3AB483, #AFC0E3).

kawaii_tri_16: tricolor, 3 colours (#EEF4E7, #003C0B, #FDD700).

kawaii_tri_17: tricolor, 3 colours (#E1F1F7, #171776, #FDD700).

kawaii_tri_18: tricolor, 3 colours (#A6F1F7, #EA8A71, #51E7C4).

kawaii_tri_19: tricolor, 3 colours (#E7242E, #006356, #EFC757). Contains a provisional reading; see palettes_needing_review().

kawaii_four_01: four-color, 4 colours (#CFC83B, #E79970, #9BCCD0, #2E8D3A).

kawaii_four_02: four-color, 4 colours (#79792D, #75B8BC, #D46932, #3E2C27).

kawaii_multi_01: multicolor, 5 colours (#F4C8DD, #0097DC, #3BB699, #FCCE60, #E94740).

kawaii_multi_02: multicolor, 6 colours (#F6AA96, #E9470C, #8EAC7A, #77BD5B, #0091D4, #F0C82B). Contains a provisional reading; see palettes_needing_review().

kawaii_multi_03: multicolor, 7 colours (#C24831, #25A64C, #F7A211, #FF9EB2, #3D308A, #B26054, #84D2C2).

kawaii_multi_04: multicolor, 5 colours (#EECF24, #DC421F, #305761, #DDBA8F, #E3A52A).

kawaii_multi_05: multicolor, 5 colours (#E9BF35, #AA95E0, #A4AC49, #DC7B8F, #7695AA).

kawaii_multi_06: multicolor, 5 colours (#246488, #51662E, #1B2D45, #E8D3CA, #C4BFC6).

kawaii_multi_07: multicolor, 5 colours (#735944, #918D8D, #D6AF49, #BD1A22, #546F32).

kawaii_multi_08: multicolor, 5 colours (#D6A31B, #EA5034, #3B65B0, #56B552, #F4DF2A).

Details

2 of them contain a provisional reading and are marked "review" in the catalogue; see palettes_needing_review().

See also

palettes(), show_palette(), scale_colour_japanesecolors()

Examples

kawaii_bi_01
#> [1] "#5C4D8C" "#D0D959"
show_palette(kawaii_bi_01)
